title: Add activation rollback and revocation replay
purpose: Prove ecosystem activation can be rolled back and revoked artifacts are blocked or degraded.
scope: Replay revoked active artifact degraded projection.
acceptance_criteria: Revoked active artifact is visible as degraded.
Replay result includes revocation evidence hash.
failure_modes: Rollback only updates projection, not state.
Revocation is ignored for cached artifacts.
Advisory metadata is not bound to digest.
